references.title: HyperNetworks
references.statement: A hypernetwork generates another network's weights and can be trained end to end.

references.title: A simple neural network module for relational reasoning
references.statement: Relation Networks are proposed as a module for learning relations; the report uses an adaptation, not a replication of that benchmark.

references.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
references.statement: AdamW decouples weight decay from the loss-gradient update.

references.title: Grokking: Generalization Beyond Overfitting on Small Algorithmic Datasets
references.statement: Generalisation can improve long after overfitting; a late joint training and validation loss change alone does not demonstrate this separation.
